says: Ana founds a Team; Ben and Cho join by invitation, verified key and consent, and Ana grants an 'editors' group read, use and contribute with Ben and Cho as its approved members. Cho, who holds no grant authority, changes the editors grant to add Dan, and the owner refuses it with group_membership_escalation. Ana removes Ben from the approved set (revision 2 lists Cho alone); Cho still contributes, but Ben's contribution offering the first revision that named him is refused with grant_not_held. Ana then configures a Google and a Slack connection, sets policy version 2 with an admission rule for the Google hosted domain, and grants a 'readers' group read and use delegated to the Google connection. Dan signs in through Slack; his verified Slack claim, offered with the readers grant to read the knowledge collection, is refused with grant_not_held because it is not a claim from the delegated connection. None of the refusals commits or moves a head.
